question: Can a >=3-block confirmatory FCLR-014 design be frozen from local cached data before outcome inspection?
verdict_detail: FCLR-014 is BLOCKED-ON-DESIGN.  Under the registered full-C2 rule (mark+index+premium+funding) the canonical tool finds 0 feasible disjoint blocks and no contiguous untested run >=127d.  Under a mark+funding-only rule (a materially different estimand requiring a new prereg) only 2 mutually non-overlapping blocks exist (<3).  Therefore no >=3-block confirmatory design can be frozen from local data without consuming a sealed window.  Do NOT freeze a prereg on the retracted 4-block claim; do NOT re-score sealed results.
